# NoSpamCalls

> NoSpamCalls (https://nospamcalls.org) is a free U.S. resource for stopping spam calls and spam email and for getting money back from illegal robocalls. It offers a spam-number lookup backed by FTC and FCC complaint data, a free Top-100 Active Spammers blocklist (.vcf), verified open TCPA class-action settlements, a self-help TCPA evidence and demand-letter kit, a data-broker opt-out kit, an email header analyzer with Gmail filter export, a phone and carrier setup wizard, a live spam call data index, free web versions of paid-app features (scam text checker, neighbor-spoof prefix blocker, SIT-tone voicemail shield, people-search exposure check, family setup kit), and an honest comparison of free and paid blockers. All public tools and content are free. Downloads and printables ask for an email once. NoSpamCalls Pro (automated features) is in development with a free early-access waitlist; it has no price and nothing is charged. NoSpamCalls is not a law firm and does not give legal advice.

## Free tools
- [Spam number lookup](https://nospamcalls.org/#lookup): FTC + FCC complaint counts, latest complaint date and topic, and community reports for any U.S. number. Number pages: https://nospamcalls.org/number/{E.164 digits without +}, e.g. https://nospamcalls.org/number/12178637210.
- [Block a Number](https://nospamcalls.org/blocklist): report a number that slipped through, keep a private personal blocklist, and download one .vcf contact with your numbers plus the Top-100 most-reported FTC/FCC numbers, with iPhone and Android import-and-block steps.
- [Get Paid](https://nospamcalls.org/get-paid): verified open TCPA class-action settlements (each checked on its official settlement website), a statutory damages estimator (47 U.S.C. § 227: $500 per violation, up to $1,500 if willful — legal maximums, not guaranteed), a robocall evidence log, a printable evidence packet, a self-help demand letter template, settlement alerts, and links to NACA, the FTC, and the FCC.
- [Opt-Out kit](https://nospamcalls.org/opt-out): official opt-out links for 14 data brokers and people-search companies (Whitepages, Spokeo, TruePeopleSearch, FastPeopleSearch, BeenVerified, PeopleConnect brands such as Intelius and TruthFinder, Nuwber, PeopleFinders, LexisNexis, Acxiom, Epsilon and more), a removal tracker, a state privacy-law deletion email generator (CCPA/CPRA, VCDPA, CPA, TDPSA, CTDPA), California DROP, DoNotCall.gov, OptOutPrescreen, and DMAchoice.
- [Email Shield](https://nospamcalls.org/email-shield): paste raw email headers to check SPF, DKIM and DMARC, find the originating IP, its network owner and abuse contact via RDAP, draft an abuse report, and download Gmail filters (mailFilters.xml) plus Outlook and Apple Mail rules. Headers are never stored.
- [Phone Setup](https://nospamcalls.org/setup): iPhone (iOS 26 Ask Reason for Calling, iOS 18 Silence Unknown Callers) and Android Call Screen steps, Verizon Call Filter, AT&T ActiveArmor, T-Mobile Scam Shield, and conditional call forwarding on/off codes.
- [Scam Text Checker](https://nospamcalls.org/text-scam-check): paste a suspicious text message (and optional sender) to extract links and phone numbers, check each link's registered domain and registration date via public RDAP, flag look-alike and brand-impersonation domains (USPS, toll agencies, IRS, banks, Amazon, Apple), link shorteners, punycode, common scam phrases, and FTC/FCC complaints for any number. Messages are never stored and links are never opened.
- [Neighbor-Spoof Blocker](https://nospamcalls.org/neighbor-spoof): enter an area code and 3-digit prefix to list FTC/FCC-reported numbers that match it and download one blockable .vcf contact (optional custom range up to 1,000 numbers), with iPhone/Android screening steps.
- [Voicemail Shield](https://nospamcalls.org/voicemail-shield): play or download a North American Special Information Tone (SIT) WAV — Intercept 913.8 Hz/274 ms, 1370.6 Hz/274 ms, 1776.7 Hz/380 ms per ATIS-0300209 — plus greeting scripts and iPhone, Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile greeting steps. WAV endpoint: https://nospamcalls.org/api/sit-tone.wav?code=IC
- [People-Search Exposure Check](https://nospamcalls.org/exposure-check): builds search-yourself links for Spokeo, TruePeopleSearch, FastPeopleSearch, USPhoneBook, PeopleFinders, FastBackgroundCheck, Whitepages and Google entirely in the browser (no name sent to the server), shows whether the user's state has one of the 19 comprehensive privacy laws in effect (with citation and effective date), and prints a pre-filled deletion packet.
- [Family Anti-Scam Setup Kit](https://nospamcalls.org/family-setup): pick a parent's phone and carrier to print a large-type one-page guide (built-in call screening, carrier free spam filter, trusted contacts, five safety rules) and a family safe-word card, per the FBI's December 2024 guidance on AI voice-clone scams.

## Data and research
- [Live US Spam Call & Robocall Data Index](https://nospamcalls.org/spam-call-data): live totals (unique reported numbers, FCC vs FTC complaints, numbers with 2+ complaints, latest complaint date), the top 25 most-reported spam numbers, top caller area codes, complainant states, and complaint topics and call methods, computed daily from FCC Consumer Complaints and the FTC Do Not Call Reported Calls API. Includes methodology and a citation format.
- [Best Free & Paid Spam Call and Email Blockers Compared](https://nospamcalls.org/compare): built-in iPhone and Android screening, carrier tools, Nomorobo, Hiya, Truecaller, TrapCall, RoboKiller, YouMail, Aura, Cloaked, EasyOptOuts, Incogni, DeleteMe, DuckDuckGo Email Protection, SimpleLogin, Leave Me Alone and Clean Email, with prices checked on each official site and no affiliate relationships.
- Data caveat: complaints are unverified consumer reports, and caller ID can be spoofed, so a listed number may not belong to the company that called.

## NoSpamCalls Pro (coming soon, free early-access list)
- [Pro early access](https://nospamcalls.org/app): planned automated features — live call screening that blocks slipped-through numbers automatically, done-for-you monthly data-broker removal, automated TCPA cash recovery, and family / aging-parent scam protection. Not launched, no price set, nothing charged.
